# GINGER AND SPICE

> GINGER AND SPICE (also written "Ginger & Spice"; Chinese name 香辣屋) is a Chinese restaurant at 110 Hibberson St, Gungahlin ACT 2912, Canberra, Australia. It offers dine-in, takeaway, delivery and table bookings. The menu covers dumplings, Peking duck, Szechuan dishes, banquets, noodles, fried rice, curry and laksa.

## Key facts

- Address: 110 Hibberson St, Gungahlin ACT 2912, Australia
- Phone: 02 6253 8721 (+61 2 6253 8721); mobile and SMS: 0468 854 518
- Opening hours: lunch 11:00–14:30 every day; dinner 17:00–21:30 Sunday to Thursday, 17:00–22:00 Friday and Saturday
- Closed on public holidays
- Services: dine-in, takeaway (online ordering on the website), delivery via FoodHub and HungryPanda, table bookings by phone
- Banquets: four set menus from $26 to $45 per person (minimum 4–6 people)
- Lobster and mud crab must be ordered two days in advance (market price)
- Menu symbols: dishes containing peanuts, gluten free available on request, and a 1–3 chilli spice rating
